## Wave 2 Summary

This wave resolves the four open seesaw/mixing channels the S116-W2-PMNS-RESCUE workshop left after closing the lepton PMNS texture as **WALLED-AS-UNDER-DETERMINED** (`s116_lepton_pmns_texture.npz`, `S116-W2-LEPTON-PMNS-TEXTURE` FAIL mix_grp=0/4). The workshop's structural verdict was: the seesaw reweighting metric is REAL + parameter-free + spectrum-pinned + quark-inaccessible, but its SUFFICIENCY failed at the near-degenerate B-branch M_R (√(B₂/B₁)=1.0363), and — the highest-order corollary — **both** lepton (U_eL) and quark (U_dL) mixing are *under-determined* because masses fix singular VALUES, not left singular VECTORS. The carry-forwards split into:

- **The binding open channel R** (gate 2-2): the eigenVALUE-ratio R=Δm²₃₂/Δm²₂₁ of the SAME composite whose eigenVECTORS the angle-metric touched — the metric can relieve angles while the spectrum holds (S96 peak R=6.87 vs NuFIT floor [17,66]).
- **The resonance search** (gate 2-3): anchored on the S-3-closed fold-spectrum M_R form (`diag(B₁,B₂,B₃)`, fiber-spectrum eigenvalue-selection; A_K-built degenerate `diag(M₀,M₁,M₁)` forms → INFO not PASS, convention-shopping guard per CF-W2-2).
- **The under-determination pair** (gates 2-4, 2-5): the quark V_us=0.3107 "prediction" re-examined as a multistart tie-break artifact (2-4), and a first-principles test of whether the spectral action S=Tr f(D_K/Λ) LIFTS the lepton U_eL flat direction (2-5) — the gate Wave 3 (lepton-CP) is CONDITIONAL-PENDING.
- **The §VII.CK UNCONDITIONAL re-verify** (gate 2-1): a Stage-2 two-agent parallel blind cross-axis verify (per `joint-theorem-promotion.md §"Stage 2"`) that, on a clean PASS-AND, flips the D4 leg-membership theorem STAGE-3-PERMANENT → STAGE-3-PERMANENT-UNCONDITIONAL.

All five gates read pre-existing artifacts (no new diagonalization for 2-2/2-4; a τ-scan + cache-match for 2-3; an SA-orbit evaluation for 2-5; a registry-read for 2-1). The dispatch couplings are in the **reporting**, not the execution: 2-2↔2-3 report the joint (angle, R) outcome at a common M_R; 2-4↔2-5 are the quark/lepton faces of the same under-determination corollary; 2-1 is standalone.

  light-mass spectrum → oscillation ratio → measurement. The substrate IS this spectrum; the
  oscillation experiment measures it. R is invariant under the Majorana SCALE (which the substrate
  holds oscillation-anchored) and set entirely by the bowtie SHAPE — a substrate-IS spectral fact.

method:
  description: "Construct the spectral action S = Tr f(D_K/Λ) (via its leading Seeley-DeWitt moments a_0^{ζ}, a_2^{ζ}, a_4^{ζ}, zeta-regularized) as a function of the lepton-sector U_eL rotation applied through the ε_LX texture in s116_lepton_pmns_texture.npz; evaluate S along the U_eL orbit at FIXED charged-lepton masses; measure ΔS = (max_orbit S − min_orbit S)/S_total. Disambiguate: a pure spectrum-preserving U_eL conjugation leaves S INVARIANT (trace cyclicity) — the ONLY candidate lift is the §VII.BL dD_K/dε_LX texture coupling (the ε_LX deformation that does NOT act as a pure conjugation)."
  producing_script: "computations/session-117/s117_uel_flat_direction.py"

operator:
  type: "inequality"

    Claim: a pure-spectrum functional Tr f(D_K/Λ) is invariant under U_eL flavor rotations that

    Def 1: S = Tr f(D_K/Λ)  — a spectral functional; depends ONLY on the eigenvalues {λ_k} of D_K.
    Def 2: U_eL a unitary flavor rotation acting as conjugation: D_K ↦ U_eL D_K U_eL†

       which need NOT act as a pure conjugation (the ε_LX deformation can couple to a fixed
       external basis or shift the spectrum) ⇒ ΔS ≠ 0 ⇒ LIFTED ⇒ substrate-SELECTED.
    Direction: the gate measures whether the §VII.BL texture coupling makes S U_eL-DEPENDENT
       (ΔS/S_total > ε_flat ⇒ lifted) or U_eL-INVARIANT (≤ ε_flat ⇒ flat).
    Conclusion: PASS (flat) iff ΔS/S_total ≤ ε_flat across the orbit ⇒ under-determination
       confirmed; FAIL (lifted) iff ΔS/S_total > ε_flat with a definite SA-minimizing U_eL ⇒
       mixing substrate-SELECTED (observed PMNS is a prediction at the SA-min U_eL).

## Wave 2 → Wave 3 Decision Point

**Wave 3 (Lepton-CP & baryogenesis, dirac-antimatter-theorist) depends on gate 2-5 `CF-S117-UEL-FLAT-DIRECTION`.** The W-1 workshop (`s116-jpmns-forced-vs-artifact.md`) closed J_PMNS=0-forced as ANSATZ-ARTIFACT-as-derived / **CONDITIONAL-PENDING-CF-W2-1** (= gate 2-5). The branch:

| Gate 2-5 verdict | Wave-3 lepton-CP reading | Action |
|:-----------------|:-------------------------|:-------|
| **PASS (flat)** | Under-determination CONFIRMED: the SA does not select U_eL ⇒ J_PMNS=0 is an ANSATZ-ARTIFACT within a free family. | Wave-3 proceeds under the under-determination reading; the three-way / baryo-channel / joint-image CFs adjudicate the free-family structure, NOT a forced derivation. |
| **FAIL (lifted)** | Mixing substrate-SELECTED: the observed PMNS (incl. δ_CP) is a prediction at the SA-min U_eL ⇒ J_PMNS=0 may be a GENUINE derived prediction at that point. | Wave-3 proceeds under the substrate-SELECTED reading; lepton-CP becomes a forced prediction to test against NuFIT δ_CP. |
| **INFO (partial)** | Regulator-class-dependent lift; flat-vs-lifted unresolved. | Wave-3 retains the CONDITIONAL-PENDING-CF-W2-1 tag; lepton-CP adjudication waits on a FULL-zeta re-run of 2-5. |

**Intra-wave reporting couplings** (NOT dispatch dependencies — all five gates run on pre-existing inputs):
- **2-2 ↔ 2-3**: gate 2-3 MUST report `mix_grp` AND `R = Δm²₃₂/Δm²₂₁` JOINTLY at each candidate M_R; gate 2-2's R at the bare B-branch M_R is the `mix_grp=0` baseline of that joint surface. A 2-3 PASS that resonates angles MUST simultaneously satisfy 2-2's R∈[17,66] at the same M_R (the angle and spectrum channels cannot be optimized independently — S-3 §IV anchor item 4).
- **2-4 ↔ 2-5**: the quark (2-4) and lepton (2-5) faces of the SAME under-determination corollary (masses fix singular values not left singular vectors). A 2-4 PASS (V_us free) + 2-5 PASS (U_eL flat) jointly confirm BOTH sectors' mixing under-determined; a 2-5 FAIL (lifted) breaks the symmetry (lepton substrate-SELECTED while quark remains free).
- **2-1**: standalone; on PASS-AND, mack flips §VII.CK → UNCONDITIONAL (a registry-write, post-gate). A 2-1 FAIL leaves §VII.CK STAGE-3-PERMANENT (D4-open) and does NOT gate any other Wave-2 item.

**Downstream registry actions** (post-Wave-2, mack sole-writer of the falsifier surface):
- 2-1 PASS-AND → §VII.CK STAGE-3-PERMANENT → STAGE-3-PERMANENT-UNCONDITIONAL.
- 2-3 FAIL → finalize the §VII.CK D4 RESONANT-CONDITIONAL (~2.9×) annotation to WALLED-AS-UNDER-DETERMINED (routed via S116-housekeeping §A item A2).
- 2-4 PASS + 2-5 result → §VII.BL/§VII.CK under-determination annotation (both sectors' mixing under-determined; the V_us=0.3107 / U_eL-1.53× soft walls).
